item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Iran Threatens Retaliation Over U.S. Blockade
item.summary: Iran’s armed forces said they would attempt to expand their influence over sea lanes beyond the Strait of Hormuz if the U.S. military continued to block Iranian shipping.

item.title: Dodging Bombs and Drones, This Postman in Ukraine Still Delivers
item.summary: Oleksiy Klochkovsky has driven mail and parcels around the front line in Ukraine for four years. He keeps one ear tuned for danger from above.

item.title: Kuwait Detained Journalist After Comments on Iran War Images, Watchdog Says
item.summary: The country has not commented publicly about Ahmed Shihab-Eldin, who the Committee to Protect Journalists said had been charged with spreading false information.

item.title: Israel Considering Cease-fire With Lebanon, Officials Say
item.summary: Talk of a truce that would pause the war between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah in Lebanon followed rare direct talks between Israel and Lebanon in Washington on Tuesday.

item.title: Iran-Linked Ships Slow or Stop as U.S. Navy Enforces Strait of Hormuz Blockade
item.summary: More than a dozen U.S. Navy warships are enforcing a blockade on all vessels from all nations entering or leaving coastal areas or ports in Iran.

item.title: Here’s how the U.S. blockade of Iranian shipping is taking shape.
item.summary: The military’s blockade of Iranian ports aims to suppress sea traffic to and from Iran, while leaving the strait itself open.

item.title: How China’s Weapons Transfers to Iran Have Evolved Over Decades
item.summary: China has denied claims this month by U.S. intelligence that it might have shipped arms to Iran. In recent years, China has supported Iran with dual-use parts.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Claudia Sheinbaum’s War on Crime in Mexico Faces a Grim Reckoning: 133,000 Missing People
item.summary: President Claudia Sheinbaum of Mexico is under pressure to end one of her country’s most painful tragedies: the disappearance of more than 133,000 people.

item.title: Trump Breaks With Meloni, Italy’s Leader, Amid Dispute Over Pope and Iran
item.summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni was once considered one of President Trump’s closest European allies. Their friendship now appears in danger.

item.title: Ship ‘Spoofing’ in Strait of Hormuz May Compound Confusion
item.summary: A new pattern of deceptive activity by some vessels around the critical waterway suggests the new American blockade is changing how some ships linked to Iran are behaving.
